diagnostic_layout.method: same target compiler/Make-derived flags, actual extracted production type definitions; .rodata.root_pose_layout

synthetic_sh4.scope:
Execute compiled SH4 root decisions/transforms and model their CPU cost.

Synthetic objects; no geometry submission, GPU, full room, bus contention,
DMA/interrupts or whole-frame measurement. Data line counts are observed
32-byte address sets, not cache misses. Uses the existing qualified interpreter
and hwsim pipeline model; XOR #imm,R0 is checked for all 256 immediates, and
the existing ESP fixture's ROTR interpretation is checked on boundary inputs.

model.scope:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.

controls: data read of current opcode word retained
double-register move counted as one 8-byte load
store queues excluded from cached footprint
cached PREF counted separately from demand loads

synthetic_sh4.whole_frame: NOT MEASURED. Any transform-only projection uses these synthetic instruction-model cycles at nominal 200 MHz; geometry/GPU work and memory stalls are additional.

limits: No private assets, whole-game link, Flycast route, STRICT gameplay comparison, or physical Dreamcast run.
No shipped room has been shown to hit either limit.

Raw full logs/fixtures were retained in isolated /tmp output; the lane scripts reproduce them.
